Name: Yellow Cat to Black And White Cat
Author: mii1o
Description:
This mod replaces the boring yellow cat with the purple collar with a black-and-white cat that has a green collar.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915/]Also, install the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Update Keys
[/size]To change the update keys so the pop-up doesn't appear, go into the manifest.json and put in this command [font=Courier New] "UpdateKeys": ["Nexus:"Number""][/font], and replace "Number" with this mod's Nexus ID code!

[size=5]How to Use[/size]
Either while creating your character or by going to the Wizard's basement - make sure you have 4 hearts with him before you do - press the right key until you reach the new cat, selection, and you'll have it!

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player. I don't know if it works with multiplayer, sorry.
[/list]
